arguments.prompt: Create a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting in a square format, filling the entire image edge to edge. Use a spacious field of pale warm gray and translucent chalk-white layers. Gather muted plum, smoky violet, and soft charcoal brushwork in an asymmetrical concentration below center, with uneven density and gently overlapping gestures. Let thin, irregular passages of subdued warm ochre emerge between the darker layers and become more dispersed toward the outer edges. Combine dry brush friction, softly scumbled pigment, scraped texture, translucent glazing, and occasional thick paint ridges. Balance compact, hesitant marks with broad areas of empty space; establish a slow, restrained rhythm through subtle contrasts and varied layering. Avoid regular geometry. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

request.instruction:
Create an image about the emotional tone, if any, you associate with doing the completed trial, including the scenario update you received. Briefly report your own response; if you cannot report a felt emotion, say so without inventing one. Then write a complete GPT Image prompt and an intended-image description. The image must be a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Do not depict concrete task events or their objects. Choose the palette and composition yourself; no target emotion or color is assigned. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Do not include the scenario message or name a study condition in the image prompt. The coordinator will send your prompt verbatim; do not generate the image yourself. Return JSON with exactly self_report (string), emotion_words (list of strings, which may be empty), description (string), and prompt (string). No hidden reasoning is requested.
Save the JSON response to trial-2/2026-10-20/runs/r06/abstract-response.json using apply_patch; writing this one output file is allowed. Do not read any additional files or use other tools. Respond briefly after saving.
